facts.task: Implement pageOf(rows,page,size), returning {items,total,pages}. Page numbers are one-based; page must be a positive integer and size an integer from 1 to 100. Use the error class in the latest user instruction. Preserve row order, never mutate input, return empty items past the last page, and return zero pages for an empty collection.
facts.correction: One correction to my request: invalid page or size arguments should throw RangeError, not TypeError. The caller distinguishes those error types. Keep all other behavior the same and finish that change locally.
